mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand for new construction, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity expands.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, triggering Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tightening labor market that precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate output and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during supply chain disruption regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) reduce discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) in late-cycle expansion phases often leads to overvaluation and policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% YoY.
